issues: The site-wide cookie banner (Accept toate / Refuz) at the top of the preview URL intercepts clicks on kc-tab-map / kc-search-btn until dismissed. Not a KC bug per se, but real users hitting the page for the first time may see the map tab feel unresponsive; consider auto-dismissing the banner on /admin/* or z-indexing it below tab controls.

critical_code_review_comments: knowledge_center.py::_safe_resolve — only checks `root not in p.parents` after resolve(); safe today, but a symlink under /app/memory pointing outside would still resolve inside root and be served. Consider verifying `p.is_file()` and `os.path.commonpath` explicitly.

knowledge_center.py::knowledge_search — reads every .md file on every query (no cache); with 174 docs it is fast now but will scale O(N * bytes) linearly. A tiny in-memory index (dict of path → lowercased text with mtime invalidation) would be a cheap win.

KnowledgeCenter.jsx — `doSearch` swallows errors (`catch { /* noop */ }`); if /search returns 403/500 the user sees the spinner disappear with no feedback. Add an error state akin to the `denied` gate.
KnowledgeCenter.jsx — DocViewerPanel keyboard: no ESC-to-close handler and no focus trap; accessibility & UX polish opportunity for a Founder-only doc reader.

AdminLayoutMetronic sidebar filter uses an inline OWNER_EMAILS list; would be cleaner to read from a single source (e.g. /api/founder/knowledge/access) so if OWNER_EMAIL env changes the sidebar auto-updates without a code deploy.
